decisions.choice: then who can be saved: many took riches as a sign of God's favor
decisions.reason: Scripture speaks of wealth as a blessing from God (Deuteronomy 28:1-14). If even the rich, whom God seemed to favor, cannot enter, then who can?

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Τὰ ἀδύνατα παρὰ ἀνθρώποις δυνατὰ παρὰ τῷ θεῷ ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: But he said, The things impossible with men possible with God are.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "The things impossible with {{gender:people|men}} are possible with God."
en.B: He answered, "What human beings cannot do is possible for God."
en.R: Jesus answered, "Some things are impossible for people, but they are possible for God."

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: «Las cosas imposibles para {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} son posibles para Dios».
es.B: Él respondió: «Lo que es imposible para los seres humanos es posible para Dios».
es.R: Jesús respondió: «Hay cosas que son imposibles para las personas, pero son posibles para Dios».

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Ce qui est impossible auprès des {{gender:humains|hommes}} est possible auprès de Dieu. »
fr.B: Il répondit : « Ce que les êtres humains ne peuvent pas faire est possible pour Dieu. »
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Certaines choses sont impossibles pour les gens, mais elles sont possibles pour Dieu. »

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} akasema, "Mambo ambayo hayawezekani kwa binadamu yanawezekana kwa Mungu."
sw.B: Yesu alijibu, "Kile ambacho binadamu hawawezi kufanya, kwa Mungu kinawezekana."
sw.R: Yesu alijibu, "Kuna mambo ambayo watu hawawezi kuyafanya, lakini Mungu anaweza kuyafanya."

decisions.choice: impossible with people, possible with God
decisions.reason: The words echo the angel's words to Mary (1:37) and the LORD's question to Abraham (Genesis 18:14). Salvation is God's work, not human work.

decisions.choice: men: human beings
decisions.reason: The word means people in general.

decisions.choice: What human beings cannot do
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the saying in natural order.

source.text: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος· Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφέντες τὰ ἴδια ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι.

records.literal_gloss: Said then Peter, Behold we having left the own things followed you.

en.L: And Peter said, "Look, we have left our own [things] and followed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: Peter said, "But we have given up what was ours and followed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!"
en.R: Then Peter said, "We left our homes and everything we had so that we could follow {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."

es.L: Y Pedro dijo: «Mira, nosotros, dejando lo nuestro, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hemos seguido».
es.B: Pedro dijo: «¡Pero nosotros hemos dejado lo que era nuestro y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hemos seguido!».
es.R: Entonces Pedro dijo: «Nosotros dejamos nuestras casas y todo lo que teníamos para poder seguirte».

fr.L: Et Pierre dit : « Voici, nous avons laissé ce qui était à nous et nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons suivi. »
fr.B: Pierre dit : « Mais nous, nous avons quitté ce que nous avions pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} suivre ! »
fr.R: Alors Pierre a dit : « Nous avons quitté nos maisons et tout ce que nous avions pour pouvoir {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} suivre. »

sw.L: Naye Petro akasema, "Tazama, sisi tumeacha vitu vyetu wenyewe, tukakufuata."
sw.B: Petro alisema, "Lakini sisi tumeacha vyote tulivyokuwa navyo, tukakufuata!"
sw.R: Kisha Petro alisema, "Sisi tuliacha nyumba zetu na kila kitu tulichokuwa nacho ili tukufuate."

decisions.choice: our own things: our homes and all we had
decisions.reason: The phrase means one's own possessions, or one's home (John 19:27). Peter and the others had left their boats and homes (5:11).

decisions.choice: we: Peter sets the disciples beside the rich man
decisions.reason: The pronoun is emphatic. The disciples have done what the ruler would not do.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: our homes and everything we had
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase, as the meaning decision does.

decisions.choice: Mira (L); left out (B, R)
decisions.reason: Peter's "look" calls attention to what he says. Literal keeps it as "mira", spoken to one person; Balanced and Readable let the order and the "pero" carry it, as the English leaves it out.

decisions.choice: Tazama (L); left out (B, R)
decisions.reason: Peter's "look" calls attention to what he says. Literal keeps it as "tazama"; Balanced and Readable let "lakini" and the order carry it, as the English leaves it out.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐδείς ἐστιν ὃς ἀφῆκεν οἰκίαν ἢ γυναῖκα ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ γονεῖς ἢ τέκνα ἕνεκεν τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ, ὃς οὐχὶ μὴ ἀπολάβῃ πολλαπλασίονα ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τῷ ἐρχομένῳ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, Truly I say to you that no one there is who has left house or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God, \v 30 who not not shall receive manifold more in the time this, and in the age that coming life eternal.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Truly I tell you that there is no one who has left house or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God \v 30 who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the age that is coming, eternal life."
en.B: He answered them, "Truly I tell you, anyone who has left a house, a wife, brothers, parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God \v 30 is sure to be given back far more in this life, and in the age that is coming, eternal life."
en.R: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth. Anyone who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the kingdom of God \v 30 will get back much more in this life. And in the age that is coming, that person will have eternal life."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que no hay nadie que haya dejado casa o mujer o hermanos o padres o hijos por causa del reino de Dios \v 30 que no reciba muchas veces más en este tiempo, y en la era que viene, vida eterna».
es.B: Él les respondió: «En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que todo el que haya dejado casa, esposa, hermanos, padres o hijos por causa del reino de Dios \v 30 recibirá sin falta mucho más en esta vida, y en la era que viene, la vida eterna».
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad. El que haya dejado su casa, su esposa, sus hermanos, sus padres o sus hijos por el reino de Dios \v 30 recibirá mucho más en esta vida. Y en la era que viene, esa persona tendrá la vida eterna».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « En vérité, je vous le dis : il n’y a personne qui ait laissé maison, ou femme, ou frères, ou parents, ou enfants, à cause du royaume de Dieu, \v 30 qui ne reçoive beaucoup plus en ce temps-ci, et, dans l’âge qui vient, la vie éternelle. »
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « En vérité, je vous le dis, quiconque aura quitté une maison, une femme, des frères, des parents ou des enfants à cause du royaume de Dieu \v 30 recevra sûrement bien davantage dans cette vie, et, dans l’âge qui vient, la vie éternelle. »
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité. Celui qui a quitté sa maison, ou sa femme, ou ses frères, ou ses parents, ou ses enfants à cause du royaume de Dieu \v 30 recevra beaucoup plus dans cette vie. Et dans le monde à venir, il aura la vie éternelle. »

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Kweli nawaambia, hakuna mtu aliyeacha nyumba au mke au ndugu au wazazi au watoto kwa ajili ya ufalme wa Mungu, \v 30 ambaye hatapokea mara nyingi zaidi katika wakati huu, na katika zama zijazo uzima wa milele."
sw.B: Aliwajibu, "Kweli nawaambia, mtu yeyote aliyeacha nyumba, mke, ndugu, wazazi au watoto kwa ajili ya ufalme wa Mungu, \v 30 hakika atapewa zaidi sana katika maisha haya, na katika zama zijazo atapokea uzima wa milele."
sw.R: Yesu aliwaambia, "Nawaambia ukweli. Mtu yeyote aliyeacha nyumba yake, au mke wake, au ndugu zake, au wazazi wake, au watoto wake kwa ajili ya ufalme wa Mungu, \v 30 atapata zaidi sana katika maisha haya. Na katika zama zijazo mtu huyo atakuwa na uzima wa milele."

decisions.choice: many times more: far more than what was given up
decisions.reason: Jesus does not name a number. The new family of God's people more than makes up for what is left (8:21).

decisions.choice: this time ... the age to come: the present age and the age God will bring in
alternatives: two periods of a person's life
decisions.reason: Jewish teaching spoke of this age and the age to come. Eternal life is the life of the age to come, which the ruler asked about (18:18).

decisions.choice: brothers: brothers, and perhaps brothers and sisters
decisions.reason: The plural can include sisters; the list here is given from the point of view of a man who leaves a wife.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (L, B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: Luke's usual rendering of Jesus' "amen" (4:24).

decisions.choice: anyone who has left ... will get back
alternatives: there is no one who has left ... who will not receive
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the double negative into a plain statement with the same meaning.

decisions.choice: ndugu
decisions.reason: The Greek word is "brothers", which here may take in sisters too (meaning decision m3). "Ndugu" covers both, so it keeps that open; in Mark 10:29 brothers and sisters are listed apart, and there "kaka" and "dada" tell them apart.

source.text: Παραλαβὼν δὲ τοὺς δώδεκα εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ, καὶ τελεσθήσεται πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα διὰ τῶν προφητῶν τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου·

records.literal_gloss: Having taken aside then the Twelve he said to them, Behold we go up to Jerusalem, and will be accomplished all things having been written through the prophets about the Son of Man;

en.L: And taking the Twelve aside, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that has been written through the prophets about the Son of Man will be accomplished.
en.B: Taking the Twelve aside, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told them, "We are now going up to Jerusalem, and all that the prophets wrote about the Son of Man will come to pass.
en.R: Jesus took the twelve apostles aside and said to them, "We are now going up to Jerusalem. There everything the prophets wrote about the Son of Man will happen.

es.L: Y tomando aparte a los Doce, les dijo: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, subimos a Jerusalén, y se llevará a cabo todo lo escrito por medio de los profetas acerca del Hijo del Hombre.
es.B: Jesús tomó aparte a los Doce y les dijo: «Ahora subimos a Jerusalén, y todo lo que escribieron los profetas acerca del Hijo del Hombre va a cumplirse.
es.R: Jesús llevó aparte a los doce apóstoles y les dijo: «Ahora vamos subiendo a Jerusalén. Allí sucederá todo lo que los profetas escribieron acerca del Hijo del Hombre.

fr.L: Et prenant à part les Douze, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Voici, nous montons à Jérusalem, et tout ce qui a été écrit par les prophètes au sujet du Fils de l’homme sera accompli.
fr.B: Il prit les Douze à part et leur dit : « Nous montons maintenant à Jérusalem, et tout ce que les prophètes ont écrit au sujet du Fils de l’homme va s’accomplir.
fr.R: Jésus a pris à part les douze apôtres et leur a dit : « Maintenant, nous montons à Jérusalem. Là, tout ce que les prophètes ont écrit au sujet du Fils de l’homme va arriver.

sw.L: Naye akiwachukua wale Kumi na Wawili kando, akawaambia, "Tazama, tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na yote yaliyoandikwa kupitia manabii kumhusu Mwana wa Adamu yatakamilika.
sw.B: Aliwachukua wale Kumi na Wawili kando, akawaambia, "Sasa tunapanda kwenda Yerusalemu, na kila kitu ambacho manabii waliandika kuhusu Mwana wa Adamu kitatimia.
sw.R: Yesu aliwachukua mitume kumi na wawili kando, akawaambia, "Sasa tunakwenda Yerusalemu. Huko kila kitu ambacho manabii waliandika kuhusu Mwana wa Adamu kitatokea.

decisions.choice: everything written through the prophets will be accomplished
alternatives: the prophets predicted only his death
decisions.reason: Jesus' suffering and rising fulfill what God said through the prophets (24:25-27, 44-46). The passive points to God's plan.

decisions.choice: about the Son of Man: what was written of him, or what will be done to him
alternatives: written by the Son of Man
decisions.reason: The phrase can go with "written" or with "accomplished". The sense is the same: Scripture is fulfilled in what happens to him.

decisions.choice: going up to Jerusalem: Jerusalem stands high in the hills
decisions.reason: From Jericho (18:35) the road climbs steeply up to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: There
decisions.reason: Readable says where these things will happen.

decisions.choice: the quotation opens here and runs to 18:33
decisions.reason: Jesus' words in 18:31-33 are one speech.

decisions.choice: los Doce (L, B); los doce apóstoles (R)
decisions.reason: The term used across the Gospels in the New Testament drafts: "los Doce" as the name of the group, and Readable says who they were, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: wale Kumi na Wawili (L, B); mitume kumi na wawili (R)
decisions.reason: The term used across the Gospels in the New Testament drafts: "wale Kumi na Wawili" as the name of the group, and Readable says who they were, as the English Readable does.

source.text: παραδοθήσεται γὰρ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐμπαιχθήσεται καὶ ὑβρισθήσεται καὶ ἐμπτυσθήσεται, καὶ μαστιγώσαντες ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν, καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ ἀναστήσεται.

records.literal_gloss: He will be betrayed for to the Gentiles and will be mocked and will be insulted and will be spit upon, \v 33 and having flogged they will kill him, and on the day the third he will rise again.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be handed over to the Gentiles, and will be mocked and insulted and spat upon, \v 33 and having flogged [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}], they will kill {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and on the third day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will rise again."
en.B: He will be given over to the Gentiles, who will make fun of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, treat {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} shamefully and spit on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 33 After whipping {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} they will put {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to death, and on the third day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will rise."
en.R: He will be handed over to people who are not Jews. They will laugh at {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, insult {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and spit on {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 33 They will beat {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with whips and kill {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. But on the third day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will come back to life."

es.L: Porque será entregado a los gentiles, y será escarnecido, y ultrajado, y escupido, \v 33 y después de azotar[lo], {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} matarán, y al tercer día resucitará».
es.B: Será entregado a los gentiles, que se burlarán de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} tratarán con desprecio y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} escupirán. \v 33 Después de azotarlo, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} matarán, y al tercer día resucitará».
es.R: Lo entregarán a personas que no son judías. Ellas se burlarán de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} insultarán y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} escupirán. \v 33 Lo golpearán con látigos y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} matarán. Pero al tercer día volverá a la vida».

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera livré aux nations, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera tourné en dérision, outragé et couvert de crachats, \v 33 et après [{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}]avoir flagellé, ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tueront, et le troisième jour {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ressuscitera. »
fr.B: Il sera livré aux non-Juifs, qui se moqueront de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}humilieront et cracheront sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \v 33 Après {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avoir fouetté, ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mettront à mort, et le troisième jour {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ressuscitera. »
fr.R: Il sera livré à des gens qui ne sont pas juifs. Ils se moqueront de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}insulteront et ils cracheront sur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \v 33 Ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} frapperont à coups de fouet et ils {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} tueront. Mais le troisième jour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} reviendra à la vie. »

sw.L: Kwa maana atakabidhiwa kwa watu wa mataifa, naye atadhihakiwa, na kutukanwa, na kutemewa mate, \v 33 na baada ya kumpiga mijeledi, watamuua, na siku ya tatu atafufuka."
sw.B: Atakabidhiwa kwa watu wa mataifa, nao watamdhihaki, watamtendea kwa aibu na kumtemea mate. \v 33 Baada ya kumpiga mijeledi watamuua, na siku ya tatu atafufuka."
sw.R: Atakabidhiwa kwa watu ambao si Wayahudi. Watamcheka, watamtukana na kumtemea mate. \v 33 Watampiga kwa mijeledi na kumuua. Lakini siku ya tatu atakuwa hai tena."

decisions.choice: handed over: given into the power of others
decisions.reason: As in 9:44: the verb is used for Judas' betrayal (22:4) and for the leaders handing Jesus to Pilate (23:1; 24:20).

decisions.choice: the Gentiles: the nations other than Israel, here the Romans
decisions.reason: This is the first time in Luke that Jesus says the Gentiles will put him to death. Roman soldiers mocked and crucified him (23:33, 36).

decisions.choice: mocked, insulted, spat upon
decisions.reason: The words recall the servant of the Lord in Isaiah 50:6, who gave his back to those who beat him and did not hide his face from spitting.

decisions.choice: flogged: whipped with a scourge
decisions.reason: The Romans flogged prisoners with leather whips, often before crucifixion.

decisions.choice: people who are not Jews
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word.

decisions.choice: the quotation closes here
decisions.reason: Luke speaks in 18:34.

decisions.choice: los gentiles (L, B); personas que no son judías (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is "the nations", the peoples other than Israel, here the Romans (meaning decision m2). "Los gentiles" is the usual Spanish for non-Jews; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: les nations (L); les non-Juifs (B); des gens qui ne sont pas juifs (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's terms for the New Testament; "les païens" carries a judgment the word does not have here, where it means the Romans (m2). Readable follows the English "people who are not Jews".

decisions.choice: watu wa mataifa (L, B); watu ambao si Wayahudi (R)
decisions.reason: "Mataifa" alone means the nations; "watu wa mataifa" is the usual Swahili for the Gentiles, here the Romans (meaning decision m2). Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐδὲν τούτων συνῆκαν, καὶ ἦν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο κεκρυμμένον ἀπ’ αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκον τὰ λεγόμενα.

records.literal_gloss: And they none of these things understood, and was the word this hidden from them, and neither they knew the things being spoken.

en.L: And they understood none of these things, and this saying was hidden from them, and they did not know the things being said.
en.B: But the Twelve understood none of this. What {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said was hidden from them, and they did not grasp what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} meant.
en.R: But the apostles did not understand any of this. The meaning of these words was hidden from them. They had no idea what Jesus meant.

es.L: Pero ellos no captaron ninguna de estas cosas, y este dicho estaba oculto para ellos, y no sabían lo que se estaba diciendo.
es.B: Pero los Doce no entendieron nada de esto. Lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} decía les quedaba oculto, y no lograban captar lo que quería decir.
es.R: Pero los apóstoles no entendieron nada de esto. El sentido de estas palabras estaba escondido para ellos. No tenían idea de lo que Jesús quería decir.

fr.L: Et eux ne comprirent rien de cela, et cette parole leur était cachée, et ils ne connaissaient pas ce qui était dit.
fr.B: Mais les Douze ne comprirent rien à tout cela. Ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} disait leur restait caché, et ils ne saisissaient pas ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voulait dire.
fr.R: Mais les apôtres n’ont rien compris à tout cela. Le sens de ces paroles leur était caché. Ils ne savaient pas du tout ce que Jésus voulait dire.

sw.L: Nao hawakuelewa lolote kati ya mambo haya, na neno hili lilikuwa limefichwa kwao, wala hawakujua yaliyokuwa yakisemwa.
sw.B: Lakini wale Kumi na Wawili hawakuelewa lolote kati ya hayo. Maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yalifichika kwao, wala hawakutambua alichomaanisha.
sw.R: Lakini mitume hawakuelewa chochote kuhusu mambo hayo. Maana ya maneno hayo ilifichwa kwao. Hawakujua Yesu alimaanisha nini.

decisions.choice: was hidden: its meaning was kept from them for a time
decisions.reason: As in 9:45. Only after the resurrection were their minds opened (24:45).

decisions.choice: three statements of one fact
decisions.reason: Luke says three times that they did not understand, to stress how far they were from seeing it.

decisions.choice: the Twelve (B); the apostles (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who did not understand.

source.text: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἐγγίζειν αὐτὸν εἰς Ἰεριχὼ τυφλός τις ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ἐπαιτῶν.

records.literal_gloss: It came to pass then in the drawing near of him to Jericho a blind [man] certain was sitting beside the road begging.

en.L: And it happened, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} drew near to Jericho, [that] a certain blind man was sitting beside the road, begging.
en.B: Jesus was approaching Jericho. A blind man was sitting there beside the road, begging.
en.R: Jesus was coming near the city of Jericho. A blind man was sitting by the side of the road. He was begging people for money.

es.L: Y ocurrió que, cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se acercaba a Jericó, cierto ciego estaba sentado a la orilla del camino pidiendo limosna.
es.B: Jesús se acercaba a Jericó. Allí, junto al camino, estaba sentado un ciego que pedía limosna.
es.R: Jesús se acercaba a la ciudad de Jericó. Un hombre ciego estaba sentado a un lado del camino. Les pedía dinero a los que pasaban.

fr.L: Et il arriva, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} approchait de Jéricho, [qu’]un aveugle était assis au bord du chemin, mendiant.
fr.B: Comme Jésus approchait de Jéricho, un aveugle était assis là, au bord de la route, et mendiait.
fr.R: Jésus arrivait près de la ville de Jéricho. Un aveugle était assis au bord de la route. Il demandait de l’argent aux gens.

sw.L: Basi ikatokea kwamba, alipokuwa anakaribia Yeriko, kipofu fulani alikuwa amekaa kando ya barabara, akiombaomba.
sw.B: Yesu alipokuwa akikaribia Yeriko, kipofu mmoja alikuwa ameketi pale kando ya njia, akiomba msaada.
sw.R: Yesu alikuwa akikaribia mji wa Yeriko. Kipofu mmoja alikuwa ameketi kando ya barabara. Alikuwa akiwaomba watu fedha.

decisions.choice: Jericho: an old city near the Jordan, about a day's walk from Jerusalem
alternatives: the Jericho of Joshua's time only
decisions.reason: The road from Jericho climbed up to Jerusalem (10:30). Pilgrims to the Passover passed this way, so it was a good place to beg.

decisions.choice: begging: asking for gifts to live on
decisions.reason: A blind man had no other way to earn a living. Giving to the poor was a duty in Jewish life.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus at the start of a new section.

source.text: ἀκούσας δὲ ὄχλου διαπορευομένου ἐπυνθάνετο τί εἴη τοῦτο·

records.literal_gloss: Having heard now a crowd passing along, he was asking what might be this.

en.L: And hearing a crowd passing by, he was asking what this might be.
en.B: He heard a crowd passing by and asked what it was all about.
en.R: He heard a crowd of people going by. He asked what was going on.

es.L: Y al oír pasar una multitud, preguntaba qué era aquello.
es.B: Oyó que pasaba una multitud y preguntó de qué se trataba.
es.R: Oyó que pasaba mucha gente. Preguntó qué estaba ocurriendo.

fr.L: Et entendant une foule qui passait, il s’informait de ce que cela pouvait être.
fr.B: Entendant passer une foule, il demanda ce qui se passait.
fr.R: Il a entendu une foule de gens qui passait. Il a demandé ce qui se passait.

sw.L: Naye aliposikia umati ukipita, akawa akiuliza ni nini hicho.
sw.B: Aliposikia umati wa watu ukipita, aliuliza kuna nini.
sw.R: Alisikia umati wa watu ukipita. Akauliza kulikuwa na nini.

decisions.choice: he was asking: he kept asking
decisions.reason: The tense suggests he asked more than once, or asked those around him.

source.text: ἀπήγγειλαν δὲ αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος παρέρχεται.

records.literal_gloss: They told then him, Jesus the Nazarene is passing by.

en.L: And they reported to him, "Jesus the Nazarene is passing by."
en.B: They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is going by."
en.R: People told him, "Jesus from Nazareth is going by."

es.L: Y le anunciaron: «Pasa Jesús el nazareno».
es.B: Le dijeron: «Es Jesús de Nazaret, que va pasando».
es.R: La gente le dijo: «Jesús de Nazaret está pasando por aquí».

fr.L: Et on lui annonça : « Jésus le Nazaréen passe. »
fr.B: On lui dit : « C’est Jésus de Nazareth qui passe. »
fr.R: Des gens lui ont dit : « Jésus, l’homme de Nazareth, passe par ici. »

sw.L: Wakamwarifu, "Yesu Mnazareti anapita."
sw.B: Walimwambia, "Yesu wa Nazareti anapita."
sw.R: Watu walimwambia, "Yesu kutoka Nazareti anapita."

decisions.choice: the Nazarene: the man from Nazareth
alternatives: a member of a religious group
decisions.reason: The word identifies Jesus by his hometown (4:16).

decisions.choice: they told him: given as their words
decisions.reason: The Greek introduces the words with a particle that can mark either a quotation or reported speech. All levels quote them.

decisions.choice: of Nazareth (B); from Nazareth (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the town.

source.text: καὶ ἐβόησεν λέγων· Ἰησοῦ υἱὲ Δαυίδ, ἐλέησόν με.

records.literal_gloss: And he called out saying, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

en.L: And he called out, saying, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
en.B: So he shouted, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
en.R: So he shouted, "Jesus, Son of David, please have mercy on me!"

es.L: Y gritó, diciendo: «¡Jesús, Hijo de David, ten piedad de mí!».
es.B: Entonces se puso a gritar: «¡Jesús, Hijo de David, ten piedad de mí!».
es.R: Entonces gritó: «¡Jesús, Hijo de David, por favor, ten compasión de mí!».

fr.L: Et il cria, en disant : « Jésus, Fils de David, aie pitié de moi ! »
fr.B: Alors il se mit à crier : « Jésus, Fils de David, aie pitié de moi ! »
fr.R: Alors il a crié : « Jésus, Fils de David, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, aie pitié de moi ! »

sw.L: Naye akapaza sauti, akisema, "Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!"
sw.B: Basi alipiga kelele, "Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!"
sw.R: Basi alipiga kelele, "Yesu, Mwana wa Daudi, tafadhali nihurumie!"

decisions.choice: Son of David: the King God promised from David's family, the Messiah
alternatives: a descendant of David by birth only
decisions.reason: God promised David a son whose kingdom would last forever (2 Samuel 7:12-16; Isaiah 11:1-10). The angel said God would give Jesus David's throne (1:32). The blind man calls Jesus by this title, which the crowd only called "Jesus the Nazarene".

decisions.choice: have mercy on me: take pity on me and help me
decisions.reason: As in 17:13. He asks the King to act with kindness.

decisions.choice: ten piedad de mí (L, B); ten compasión de mí (R)
decisions.reason: A cry to someone able to help, asking him to take pity and act (meaning decision m2). "Ten piedad" is the living form of that plea, as in Mark 10:47; Readable uses the everyday "compasión". The same in verse 39.

decisions.choice: nihurumie (every level)
decisions.reason: The blind man asks for pity that acts to help him (meaning decision m2). "Kuhurumia" is the everyday word for that and suits a cry from the roadside, as the term sheet for the New Testament drafts sets; Readable adds "tafadhali" as the English Readable adds "please". The same in verse 39.

source.text: καὶ οἱ προάγοντες ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ ἵνα σιγήσῃ· αὐτὸς δὲ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἔκραζεν· Υἱὲ Δαυίδ, ἐλέησόν με.

records.literal_gloss: And those going before were rebuking him that he should be silent; he however much more kept crying out, Son of David, have mercy on me.

en.L: And those going ahead were rebuking him, that he should be silent; but he kept crying out much more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
en.B: The people at the front of the crowd told him sternly to be quiet, but he cried out all the louder, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
en.R: The people walking in front told him to be quiet. But he shouted even louder, "Son of David, please have mercy on me!"

es.L: Y los que iban delante lo reprendían para que se callara; pero él gritaba mucho más: «¡Hijo de David, ten piedad de mí!».
es.B: Los que iban al frente le ordenaban con dureza que se callara, pero él gritaba todavía más: «¡Hijo de David, ten piedad de mí!».
es.R: La gente que caminaba delante le dijo que se callara. Pero él gritó todavía más fuerte: «¡Hijo de David, por favor, ten compasión de mí!».

fr.L: Et ceux qui marchaient devant le réprimandaient pour qu’il se taise ; mais lui criait beaucoup plus : « Fils de David, aie pitié de moi ! »
fr.B: Les gens qui étaient en tête de la foule lui ordonnèrent sévèrement de se taire, mais il cria encore plus fort : « Fils de David, aie pitié de moi ! »
fr.R: Les gens qui marchaient en tête lui ont dit de se taire. Mais il a crié encore plus fort : « Fils de David, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, aie pitié de moi ! »

sw.L: Na wale waliokuwa wakitangulia walikuwa wakimkemea ili anyamaze; lakini yeye alizidi sana kupiga kelele, "Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!"
sw.B: Watu waliokuwa mbele walimkemea vikali anyamaze, lakini yeye alipaza sauti zaidi na zaidi, "Mwana wa Daudi, nihurumie!"
sw.R: Watu waliokuwa wakitembea mbele walimwambia anyamaze. Lakini yeye alipiga kelele kwa nguvu zaidi, "Mwana wa Daudi, tafadhali nihurumie!"

decisions.choice: those going ahead: the people at the head of the procession
decisions.reason: Luke does not say who they were. They walked in front of Jesus.

decisions.choice: kept crying out: shouted again and again
decisions.reason: The verb is a stronger word for shouting than in 18:38, and the tense shows he kept on.

decisions.choice: told him sternly
decisions.reason: Balanced says how they spoke to him.

source.text: σταθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν ἀχθῆναι πρὸς αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Having stopped then Jesus commanded him to be brought to him.

en.L: And Jesus stood still and commanded him to be brought to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Jesus stood still and gave orders for them to bring the man to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Jesus stopped. He told the people to bring the blind man to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y Jesús, deteniéndose, mandó que lo trajeran ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Jesús se detuvo y dio orden de que llevaran al hombre ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Jesús se detuvo. Dijo a la gente que llevaran al ciego hasta {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Et Jésus, s’étant arrêté, ordonna qu’on le {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amène.
fr.B: Jésus s’arrêta et ordonna qu’on {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amène l’homme.
fr.R: Jésus s’est arrêté. Il a dit aux gens de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} amener l’aveugle.

sw.L: Naye Yesu, akisimama, akaamuru aletwe {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.B: Yesu alisimama, akaamuru wamlete yule mtu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.R: Yesu alisimama. Akawaambia watu wamlete yule kipofu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.

decisions.choice: commanded him to be brought: Jesus ordered those near him
alternatives: Jesus commanded the blind man to come
decisions.reason: The passive leaves unnamed who brought the man; it was the people around.

decisions.choice: the man (B); the blind man (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear which "him" is meant.

source.text: ἐγγίσαντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτόν·

records.literal_gloss: Having drawn near then he, he asked him,

en.L: And when he had come near, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} asked him,
en.B: When the man came near, Jesus asked him,
en.R: When the man came close, Jesus asked him,

es.L: Y cuando se acercó, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le preguntó:
es.B: Cuando el hombre se acercó, Jesús le preguntó:
es.R: Cuando el hombre llegó cerca, Jesús le preguntó:

fr.L: Et quand il se fut approché, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’interrogea :
fr.B: Quand l’homme se fut approché, Jésus lui demanda :
fr.R: Quand l’homme est arrivé tout près, Jésus lui a demandé :

sw.L: Naye alipokaribia, akamwuliza,
sw.B: Yule mtu alipokaribia, Yesu alimwuliza,
sw.R: Yule mtu alipofika karibu, Yesu alimwuliza,

decisions.choice: he drew near ... he asked: the blind man came near, and Jesus asked
decisions.reason: The first "he" is the blind man, the second is Jesus.

decisions.choice: the man ... Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name both people.

source.text: Τί σοι θέλεις ποιήσω;

records.literal_gloss: What to you do you want I shall do?

en.L: "What do you want {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to do for you?"
en.B: "What would you like {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to do for you?"
en.R: "What do you want {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to do for you?"

es.L: «¿Qué quieres que te haga?».
es.B: «¿Qué te gustaría que hiciera por ti?».
es.R: «¿Qué quieres que haga por ti?».

fr.L: « Que veux-tu que je fasse pour toi ? »
fr.B: « Que voudrais-tu que je fasse pour toi ? »
fr.R: « Qu’est-ce que tu veux que je fasse pour toi ? »

sw.L: "Unataka {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nikufanyie nini?"
sw.B: "Ungependa nikufanyie nini?"
sw.R: "Unataka nikufanyie nini?"

decisions.choice: what do you want me to do for you: Jesus invites the man to say what he asks
decisions.reason: Jesus can see that the man is blind. He asks him to put his request and his trust into words.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Κύριε, ἵνα ἀναβλέψω.

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Lord, that I might receive sight.

en.L: And he said, "Lord, that I may receive sight."
en.B: He answered, "Lord, I want to see again."
en.R: The man answered, "Lord, I want to be able to see again."

es.L: Y él dijo: «Señor, que yo recobre la vista».
es.B: Él respondió: «Señor, quiero volver a ver».
es.R: El hombre respondió: «Señor, quiero poder ver otra vez».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Seigneur, que je recouvre la vue ! »
fr.B: Il répondit : « Seigneur, je veux voir de nouveau. »
fr.R: L’homme a répondu : « Seigneur, je voudrais pouvoir voir à nouveau. »

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Bwana, nipate kuona tena."
sw.B: Alijibu, "Bwana, nataka kuona tena."
sw.R: Yule mtu alijibu, "Bwana, nataka kuweza kuona tena."

decisions.choice: Lord: a title of respect, here given to the Son of David
decisions.reason: The word can be a polite "sir", but this man has called Jesus the Son of David (18:38-39).

decisions.choice: receive sight: see again, or see
alternatives: see for the first time only
decisions.reason: The verb means to look up, and so to regain sight. It may mean he had once seen.

decisions.choice: I want to see again
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the request as a natural sentence.

decisions.choice: Señor
decisions.reason: The blind man uses the polite address, but he gives it to the one he has just called Son of David (meaning decision m1), so it is written with a capital, as the English "Lord" is.

decisions.choice: Bwana
decisions.reason: The blind man uses the polite address, but he gives it to the one he has just called Son of David (meaning decision m1), so it is written with a capital, as the English "Lord" is.

source.text: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἀνάβλεψον· ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε.

records.literal_gloss: And Jesus said to him, Receive sight; the faith of you has healed you.

en.L: And Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight; your faith has saved you."
en.B: Jesus told him, "See again. Your faith has made you well."
en.R: Jesus said to him, "Then see! Your faith has made you well and saved you."

es.L: Y Jesús le dijo: «Recobra la vista; tu fe te ha salvado».
es.B: Jesús le dijo: «Vuelve a ver. Tu fe te ha sanado».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «¡Recibe la vista! Tu fe te ha sanado y te ha salvado».

fr.L: Et Jésus lui dit : « Recouvre la vue ; ta foi t’a sauvé. »
fr.B: Jésus lui dit : « Vois de nouveau. Ta foi t’a guéri. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Alors, vois ! Ta foi t’a guéri et sauvé. »

sw.L: Naye Yesu akamwambia, "Pata kuona; imani yako imekuokoa."
sw.B: Yesu alimwambia, "Ona tena. Imani yako imekuponya."
sw.R: Yesu alimwambia, "Basi, ona! Imani yako imekuponya na kukuokoa."

decisions.choice: has saved you: has made you well, and more than that, has rescued you
decisions.reason: The verb means to save or rescue, and in healings to make well. Luke uses the same words for the woman whose sins were forgiven (7:50), the woman healed by touching Jesus (8:48), and the Samaritan (17:19). The man goes on to follow Jesus (18:43).

decisions.choice: your faith: his trust that Jesus, the Son of David, could and would heal him
decisions.reason: His faith showed in his cry and in his refusal to be silenced.

decisions.choice: receive sight: a command that heals
decisions.reason: Jesus heals by his word.

decisions.choice: made you well (B); made you well and saved you (R)
decisions.reason: As in 8:48 and 17:19: Literal keeps "saved", Balanced says what happened to his body, and Readable uses both words.

source.text: καὶ παραχρῆμα ἀνέβλεψεν, καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ δοξάζων τὸν θεόν.

records.literal_gloss: And immediately he received sight, and began following him glorifying God.

en.L: And immediately he received sight, and began following {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, glorifying God.
en.B: At once he could see, and he followed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, giving glory to God.
en.R: Right away the man could see again. He followed Jesus, giving glory to God.

es.L: Y al instante recobró la vista, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} seguía glorificando a Dios.
es.B: En ese mismo momento pudo ver, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} siguió dando gloria a Dios.
es.R: Enseguida el hombre pudo ver otra vez. Siguió a Jesús, dando gloria a Dios.

fr.L: Et aussitôt il recouvra la vue, et il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivait en glorifiant Dieu.
fr.B: À l’instant même, il put voir, et il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivit en rendant gloire à Dieu.
fr.R: Tout de suite, l’homme a pu voir de nouveau. Il a suivi Jésus en rendant gloire à Dieu.

sw.L: Na mara akapata kuona, akaanza kumfuata, akimtukuza Mungu.
sw.B: Mara moja aliweza kuona, akamfuata, akimpa Mungu utukufu.
sw.R: Mara hiyo yule mtu aliweza kuona tena. Akamfuata Yesu, akimtukuza Mungu.

decisions.choice: following him: going with Jesus, as a disciple does
decisions.reason: Unlike the rich ruler (18:22-23), the man who has nothing follows Jesus at once.

decisions.choice: glorifying God: praising God for what he had done
decisions.reason: As in 5:25 and 17:15.

source.text: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἰδὼν ἔδωκεν αἶνον τῷ θεῷ.

records.literal_gloss: And all the people, having seen [it], gave praise to God.

en.L: And all the people, having seen [it], gave praise to God.
en.B: All the people saw what happened, and they gave praise to God.
en.R: All the people who saw this praised God too.

es.L: Y todo el pueblo, al ver[lo], dio alabanza a Dios.
es.B: Todo el pueblo, al ver lo sucedido, alabó a Dios.
es.R: Toda la gente que vio esto también alabó a Dios.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple, ayant vu [cela], donna louange à Dieu.
fr.B: Tout le peuple vit ce qui s’était passé et rendit louange à Dieu.
fr.R: Tous les gens qui avaient vu cela ont aussi loué Dieu.

sw.L: Na watu wote, walipoona, wakatoa sifa kwa Mungu.
sw.B: Watu wote walipoona yaliyotokea, walimsifu Mungu.
sw.R: Watu wote walioona jambo hilo nao walimsifu Mungu.

decisions.choice: the people: the crowd, God's people
decisions.reason: Luke often uses this word for the crowds of Israel who heard Jesus gladly (7:16; 19:48).

decisions.choice: praise: words of praise
decisions.reason: This is a different word from "glorifying" in 18:43a, a plain word for praise.
